thread:
morgan: Quick heads-up: ran cross-device kernel profile for seq lengths 32/128/512 on L4/T4/A10 vs A100/H100. Numbers look fine for short seqs but weird for seq512 on A10.

sana: Can you paste the perf summary?

morgan: perf-bench summary:
```
A100 seq512: 1.0x baseline
H100 seq512: 0.95x
A10  seq512: 1.8x (higher latency, lower throughput)
L4/T4 seq512: 2.4x (memory-bound, high stall)
seq32: all within 1.05x
```

oleg: My hunch: on A10 we fall back to a generic FP32 GEMM path for >256, losing the quantized kernels.

morgan: Traces confirm we pick `matmul_fallback_v2` for seq>256 on A10. Kernel selector rule is too conservative.

devin: Quick proposal for preset naming and knobs: `a100_shortseq`, `a100_longseq`, `a10_longseq_legacy`, `l4_t4_membound`. Example config?

morgan: example presets snippet:
```
kernel_presets:
  - name: a10_longseq
    devices: [A10]
    seq_range: [256, 2048]
    kernels: [kv_cached_gemm, split_attention]
    batch_hint: large
  - name: l4_t4_membound
    devices: [L4, T4]
    seq_range: [128, 1024]
    kernels: [stream_attn, small_batch_kv]
    memory_limit_mb: 12000
```

ash: memory_limit for L4 looks high — we saw OOM at ~11GB on L4 during previous runs. Suggest 10000MB cap.

morgan: good catch, will set memory_limit_mb: 10000. Also plan to enable `kv_prefetch` for A10/L4 presets and change autotune target to throughput for seq>256 (latency SLOs still enforced).

perf-bot: Perf run complete: job 4523: `a10_longseq` tuned -> throughput +22% but p99 latency +7%.

sana: +22% throughput is great but +7% p99 reg is concerning for real-time routes. Can we mitigate with KV caching policies?

oleg: add `kv_prefetch: true` and reduce micro-batch size for long-seq canaries. micro_batch=1 -> helps p99 at cost of throughput.

morgan: Plan: (1) update presets (memory_limit 10000, kv_prefetch true, smaller micro-batches), (2) run overnight autotune sweep with both throughput and p99 objectives, (3) deploy canary route `canary/a10_longseq` for model.zombie-mpt-7b and watch 1h p99. Will report tomorrow.

devin: :thumbsup: I'll add the canary route + alert for p99>1.15x baseline.

morgan: Thanks — if this looks okay I'll push a PR to runtime selector and presets by EOD.
